options.message: Announcement text (no mention will notify anyone)

options.numero: Number of the announcement to cancel

automod.description: Native Discord AutoMod rules (banned words, invites, mentions, spam)

options.valeur: Comma-separated words, mention limit, or ID of the rule to delete

giveaway.description: Giveaways: start, end or reroll a draw

help.description: Shows the commands and their details

options.membre: The member whose history you want to see

privacy.description: Data kept by the bot (and deletion for administrators)

roles.description: Button role panels (members take or remove a role themselves)

stats.description: Ticket statistics for the last 30 days

action.retirer: Remove a member from this ticket
